description: Planning scaffold for generating deep-research project DAGs. Understands research question, identifies angles and sources, selects research shape (4A-4D), gathers design input, and writes the project DAG.
goal: Enable planning agents to generate valid deep-research project DAGs by understanding the research question, identifying angles and sources, selecting the right research structure, and setting up the research loop.

scout.desc: Need more context about research question or existing work
scout.choose_when: Research question or scope is unclear

propose-research-angles.desc: Research question is clear; ready to identify angles
propose-research-angles.choose_when: Sufficient understanding of what to research

propose-research-angles.desc: Research angles need adjustment; reconsider what aspects matter
propose-research-angles.choose_when: Proposed angles don't cover the research space

propose-sources.desc: Research angles are sound; ready to identify sources
propose-sources.choose_when: Research angles are appropriate and comprehensive

propose-sources.desc: Source priorities need adjustment; reconsider where to look
propose-sources.choose_when: Proposed sources don't cover the evidence space well

propose-research-shape.desc: Source priorities are sound; ready to select research shape
propose-research-shape.choose_when: Sources are well-prioritized for the research

propose-research-shape.desc: Research shape doesn't fit; reconsider research structure
propose-research-shape.choose_when: Proposed shape doesn't match the research question

identify-success-criteria.desc: Research shape is appropriate; ready to define success criteria
identify-success-criteria.choose_when: Selected shape fits the research well

finalize.desc: Research plan is sound; proceed to write the project DAG
finalize.choose_when: All research decisions are solid and ready to commit

propose-research-angles.desc: Reconsider which research angles are important

propose-sources.desc: Reconsider where to prioritize research effort

propose-research-shape.desc: Reconsider which research structure is right
propose-research-shape.choose_when: Selected shape doesn't fit the research question
